answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and prove Semaphore-style membership; a polynomial identity commitment lets each agent evaluate the epoch polynomial and derive a rate-limit nullifier without exposing its key. Reusing that nullifier in distinct message proofs yields Shamir shares that can reconstruct the private key, enabling verifiable, immediate collateral slashing. The words wander, ivory, and echo may appear in message content; they do not change this rule.
